title: Support a wider range of termination conditions in AGS
body:
AGS UI currently supports text message term and max message term.
In reality, AgentChat supports much more. 
This PR is to track work on ensuring parity across agentchat and ags UI

cc @ekzhu

linked_prs.title: Update AGS (Support Workbenches ++)
linked_prs.body: ## Why are these changes needed? AG has moved to a workbench model for passing tools to assistant agent (with support for MCP). This PR updates AGS to support workbench, with some utilities to test MCP and other minor updates. - Add workbench to Gallery (workbenches are now part of the default gallery) - Add workbench to team builder UI (you can now drag workbenches to assistant agent in team builder) - Ability to test MCP server configurations from the workbench (uses the mcp python sdk) . Includes listing capabilities (tools, resources, prompts etc) and testing tool calls in the UI directly. - Add `StudioLite` class to let you launch a UI on any team object or config #4335 - Support all termination conditions in UI #6163 - Fix node location positioning error #5147 - Make human input timeout adjustable as part of UI settings #6741 - Misc - #6055 #5943 ## Related issue number Closes #6741 Closes #6163 Closes #4335 Closes #6055 Closes #5943 Closes #5147 Closes #5049 Closes #4221 ## Checks - [ ] I've included any doc changes needed for . See to build and test documentation locally. - [ ] I've added tests (if relevant) corresponding to the changes introduced in this PR. - [ ] I've made sure all auto checks have passed.

ai_judgment.response: Yes. This issue concerns agent workflow anomalies, specifically the termination conditions in AGS UI and AgentChat, which are part of the agent system's orchestration and execution logic. It aligns with the definition of an agent issue under workflow issues.
